# 1. Ground the drawer object with camera_name and world_position
g = primitives.call(
    name='ground_robocasa_visual_target',
    camera_name='robot0_agentview_left',
    entity_name='drawer_obj',
    world_position=[2.973397, -0.368035, 0.76517]
)

h = g.output.get('evidence_handle') if (g.ok and g.output) else None

if h:
    # 2. Move EE close to the drawer handle
    primitives.call(
        name='move_robocasa_ee_to',
        evidence_handles=[h],
        target_position=[3.05, -0.368, 0.765],
        gripper_command=-1.0,
        horizon=60
    )
    # 3. Grasp the drawer handle
    primitives.call(
        name='grasp_robocasa_object',
        evidence_handles=[h],
        object_name='drawer_obj',
        gripper_command=1.0,
        horizon=60
    )
    # 4. Pull the drawer open along +X direction
    primitives.call(
        name='move_robocasa_ee_to',
        evidence_handles=[h],
        target_position=[3.35, -0.368, 0.765],
        gripper_command=1.0,
        horizon=80
    )
